cd /srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration && python - <<'PY'
import os, shutil, stat
src='imported'
dst='converted'
report='conversion-collisions.txt'
collisions=[]
copied=[]
created_dirs=[]
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(src):
    relroot=os.path.relpath(root, src) if hasattr(os.path, 'relpath') else root[len(src):].lstrip('/')
    if relroot == '.': relroot=''
    relroot_utf8=relroot.decode('iso-8859-1').encode('utf-8')
    outroot=os.path.join(dst, relroot_utf8)
    if not os.path.isdir(outroot):
        os.makedirs(outroot)
        created_dirs.append(outroot)
    for name in files:
        source=os.path.join(root,name)
        rel=os.path.join(relroot,name)
        target=os.path.join(dst,rel.decode('iso-8859-1').encode('utf-8'))
        if os.path.lexists(target):
            collisions.append((source,target))
            continue
        shutil.copy2(source,target)
        copied.append((source,target))
f=open(report,'w')
f.write('Filename conversion collisions (ISO-8859-1 -> UTF-8)\n')
for source,target in collisions:
    f.write('%s -> %s\n' % (source,target))
f.close()
print('copied=%d collisions=%d created_dirs=%d' % (len(copied),len(collisions),len(created_dirs)))
for source,target in copied:
    print('COPIED %s -> %s' % (repr(source),repr(target)))
for source,target in collisions:
    print('COLLISION %s -> %s (destination preserved; source retained)' % (repr(source),repr(target)))
